newsitem.title: USA: O'Gara to buy U.K.'s Next Generation.
newsitem.headline: O'Gara to buy U.K.'s Next Generation.

text.p: O'Gara Co said on Tuesday that it has entered into a letter of intent to acquire all of the capital stock of Next Destination Ltd, headquartered in Salisbury, U.K. for an expected price of $3.5 million.
O'Gara said it expects the acquisition to contribute to earnings beginning in 1997.
Next Destination, with offices in the U.K. and France, is a distributor of high technology products for the consumer electronic, marine, aviation, professional, and leisure markets.
The purchase price consists of $1.75 million in shares of O'Gara Company $1.75 million in seller provided financing in the form of three-year 6 percent loan notes.
The company said it expects the transaction to be consummated during January of 1997.
Revenues for Next Destination for the twelve months ending December 31, 1996 are expected to be about $8.5 million, O'Gara said.
